author: toketrain
body:
Another question about map making:

In some adventure maps, the creator puts a file in the map folder called "resources" which contains a resource pack that automatically loads up when you open the world. You don't control whether or not it's there. I know this is a singleplayer feature, but I was wondering if there was any way to add a zipped resource pack to a world save and use it in-game? I'm not talking like a changed texture for literally everything, just some retexturing/modelling for unused items in the map that could add some aesthetics.
